note: Ground truth labelled by a Claude agent from the Muse Voice Transcribe narration and 1 fps frames, blind to the model's plan; not yet human-reviewed. Uncertain: whether 'photograph the wiring' and 'finish setup in the app' count as checkable steps (both shown hands-on but end state is on a phone), and the exact split between removing the cover (25-26 s close-up) and disconnecting wires (34-38 s).

steps.instruction: Pull the cover off the old thermostat to expose its wiring.
steps.done_looks_like: The old thermostat's cover is off and its circuit board with the red and white wires is exposed on the wall.
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 1 DISCONNECT OLD THERMOSTAT' 22-25 s; she pulls the cover off at 22-24 s, screwdriver close-up on the old unit 25-26 s; transcript [21.0] 'remove the old thermostat's cover'. Card step 1 split: cover removal and the wiring photo are separate actions.

steps.instruction: Take a photo of the old wiring with your phone for reference.
steps.done_looks_like: The phone shows a photo of the exposed old wiring plate next to it.
steps.evidence: Frames 27-33 s phone photographing the plate; transcript [21.0] 'take a photo or make a note of the wiring configuration'. Still part of the STEP 1 card; split out because it is a separate hands-on action.

steps.instruction: Unscrew each wire from the old backplate terminals with a screwdriver.
steps.done_looks_like: The red and white wires are loose from the old backplate's screw terminals.
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 2 REMOVE OLD BACKPLATE' from 34 s, screwdriver at the terminals 34-38 s; transcript [32.9] 'disconnect each wire using the appropriate screwdriver'. Split from backplate removal because it has its own end state.

steps.instruction: Pull the old backplate off the wall.
steps.done_looks_like: Bare wall with only the red and white wires coming out of the hole.
steps.evidence: 39 s hands grip the plate, 40 s it comes away leaving the wires in the wall hole; transcript [38.9] 'carefully remove the backplate'. 41-46 s static wall shot (patch/repaint narration) shows no action, so left out.

steps.instruction: Hold the Nest base on the wall with the red and white wires through its centre hole and level it.
steps.done_looks_like: The round Nest base sits flat on the wall, bubble level centred, both wires poking through the middle.
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 3 POSITION NEW BASE' 48-52 s; base held on wall 47-52 s; transcript [47.7] 'position the new thermostat's base carefully bringing the wiring through the center'. Split from screwing because the card covers positioning and screwing is a distinct action.

steps.instruction: Screw the Nest base to the wall through its top and bottom screw holes.
steps.done_looks_like: Both top and bottom screws are driven in and the base is fixed to the wall.
steps.evidence: Screwdriver on top screw 53-57 s (tip 'Ensure the plate is level'), bottom screw 58-62 s; transcript 'using the provided hardware secure the base to the wall'.

steps.instruction: Push down the Rc connector button and insert the red wire into the Rc terminal.
steps.done_looks_like: The red wire's stripped end is seated in the Rc terminal on the lower-left of the base.
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 4 CONNECT WIRES' 63-71 s; full-res frames 67-69 s show the red wire being inserted at the terminal labelled 'Rc' (not Rh, which is on the right side); at 71 s red is in Rc and white still loose. Card split into one step per wire.

steps.instruction: Push down the W1 connector button and insert the white wire into the W1 terminal.
steps.done_looks_like: The white wire is seated in W1 (upper-right) and the red wire stays in Rc.
steps.evidence: 72-77 s hands on the right-hand bank pressing W1; full-res 78.5 s shows white in W1 and red in Rc; transcript [73.7] 'push down the connector button and insert the wire'.

steps.instruction: Tuck the wires into the base and push the Nest display onto it until it clicks.
steps.done_looks_like: The round Nest display is mounted on the base, covering the wiring.
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 5 ATTACH DISPLAY PANEL' 80-86 s; she tucks wires 79-82 s and presses the display on 84-86 s; transcript [79.3] 'gently push wires inside the base then push it into place until it clicks'.

steps.instruction: Finish setting up the thermostat in the phone app.
steps.done_looks_like: The app on the phone and the thermostat both show the set temperature (68).
steps.evidence: Card 'STEP 6 FINISH SET UP' 87-93 s with phone app tapping and the display reading 68; transcript [87.0] 'restore power at the breaker box and finish the setup'. Restoring power is said but not shown, so not a separate step; 94-95 s ring turned to 74 is b-roll.
